featured_reviews.name: Akshata Khandekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Perfect Tiffin Service for a Busy Lifestyle!
I’ve been using this tiffin service for the past few months, and it has truly been a blessing in my hectic schedule. With work and other daily responsibilities, I hardly had the time or energy to cook nutritious meals — that’s where this service came to the rescue.

The food is always fresh, homely, and full of variety. It reminds me of a proper ghar ka khana, which is hard to find these days. The quality and hygiene are top-notch, portions are satisfying, and delivery is always on time, which I really appreciate.

It has taken a huge load off my shoulders and helped me maintain a healthy eating routine without compromising on taste or time. Highly recommend to anyone looking for reliable, homemade food delivered daily!

featured_reviews.name: Sadayen Aleemi
featured_reviews.review_text:
No doubt this is a premium catering company,from price point of view it's a little on the premium side however definitely worth the spend.
Our event was decided in a rush and we didn't have the time for visiting any caterer or trying out their food for that matter so we booked this caterer online. We were a bit  skeptical & worried since it was our first time with them. They completely amazed us with their food & hospitality. Haven't tasted quality food like this ever before. We have promised & booked them in advance for our younger daughters wedding event which is to be held in April. I personally like the founder Mr.Wasim, an extremely humble guy & a gentleman. Though being the founder he was personally present & made sure everything was in sync. We are delightfully thankful to the entire team.

featured_reviews.name: Savita Nangare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I seriously doubt the authenticity of the positive reviews posted here. We hired this catering agency for a small, close-knit gathering and, based on the reviews, expected high-quality food. Unfortunately, the experience was terrible.
The food taste was extremely poor, and the quantity and quality of sweets provided were extremely limited and disappointing. Several people from our group complained of diarrhoea afterward, and I personally suffered from it for days.
When I shared this feedback with the owner, he was dismissive and clearly uninterested in taking responsibility or even acknowledging the issue.
A word of caution: do not rely blindly on online reviews when choosing caterers. They can be misleading, and our experience proves that firsthand.

featured_reviews.name: Maaz Ahmed
featured_reviews.review_text: Anmol Caterers is a catering company that impressed me immensely with its authentic flavors, stunning presentation, and unwavering reliability. From start to finish, their professionalism and commitment shone through. The food was a delicious journey into authenticity, and the impeccable presentation added a visual feast to the event. Anmol Caterers' reliability was amazing in a stressful event, and their staff's professionalism made the experience smooth and enjoyable. A personal highlight was when a guest, a true Indian cuisine enthusiast, raved about the authenticity of the food, comparing it to one of the better restaurants in Turkey. In summary, I highly recommend Anmol Caterers for an exceptional catering experience that combines authenticity, presentation, and reliability, making any event truly special.
